$comment: Single source of truth for the Tooltip API. Every framework package is tested against this file.
name: tooltip
title: Tooltip
description: A short hint that appears when you hover over or focus a control.
thumb: Add to libraryHover me

content.description: The hint. Keep it short and plain text.

side.description: Where it appears. It flips if there isn't room.

label.description: The tooltip is the control's name (icon buttons), not an extra description.
label.html: aria-labelledby instead of aria-describedby on the trigger

delay.description: Milliseconds before it shows on hover. Focus shows it at once.

examples.title: Basic
examples.description: Hover or focus the button. In HTML, add data-vin-tooltip="id" to the trigger and include vinui.js.

examples.title: Icon buttons
examples.description: For icon-only buttons the tooltip is the name, so it's linked with aria-labelledby.

examples.title: Sides
examples.description: Top, right, bottom or left. Near the edge of the screen it flips to the side with room.

a11y: role="tooltip", linked to the trigger with aria-describedby (or aria-labelledby when it is the name).
Shows on keyboard focus as well as hover, and Escape hides it without moving focus (WCAG 1.4.13).
You can move the pointer onto the tooltip without it closing.
Never put links or buttons in a tooltip: it can't be reached. Use a Popover for that.
